verdict.rationale: The NVIDIA B200 is GPU accelerator hardware and a DGX system platform. User-configured autonomous background automations are an application or agent-software axis, not a capability this kind of product offers. Nothing in the evidence shows the product shipping such an automation feature. The built-in health monitoring and alerts are fixed system functions, not user-defined automations, so they do not make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
